title: Enterprise Tenant Order-Sync Collapse (80% Drop) vs. Pricing Complaint Red Herring
symptom_summary: Enterprise tenant acme-logistics bulk order volume dropped over 80% starting 2026-10-23T02:01:00Z. Support ticket tkt-7003 complains about 'new pricing' and threatens churn; api-gateway v8.1.0 also deployed earlier that morning.

red_herrings.description: VIP ticket from acme-logistics complaining about pricing and threatening cancellation
red_herrings.why_plausible: Customer explicitly threatened to pull bulk order volume over pricing
red_herrings.why_falsified: Contract ledger check in {billing}.subscriptions & {billing}.plan_changes shows 0 price changes and annual lock-in; telemetry shows 1,000+ active API calls rejected with HTTP 429

red_herrings.why_plausible: Touched gateway header normalization during the morning incident window
red_herrings.why_falsified: Temporal precedence violation: 429 rate-limit drop started at 02:01:00Z (74 minutes before dep-1007)

ground_truth_root_cause.description: Config change rate_limit.enterprise_burst_per_min lowered from 500 to 60 at 2026-10-23T01:55:00Z
ground_truth_root_cause.mechanism: Automated infra-bot lowered enterprise burst limit to 60/min, throttling nightly bulk syncs across acme-logistics, orbit-freight, and helio-health
